text.p: UBS Securities said on Thursday it downgraded its rating on the shares of PairGain Technologies Inc to hold from buy, after the company reported below-forecast second quarter revenues and operating margins.
-- Analyst Nikos Theodosopoulos said he lowered his 1997 earnings estimate to $0.63 per share from $0.68 per share and his 1998 earnings estimate to $0.75 per share from $0.85.
-- PairGain reported second quarter earnings of $0.16 per share compared with $0.10 per share in the year-ago quarter, on revenues of $66.4 million.
-- Theodosopoulos said he had estimated PairGain's second quarter revenues at $67.4 million.
-- "Price declines and unit growth in HDSL (high bit-rate digital subscriber line) business will likely be worse than anticipated, which is leading to new estimates," he said in a research note.
-- The stock lost 1-3/8 to 16-7/8 in active trade.
